decisions.evidence: Overall, the molecule has some permeability-friendly features, especially low TPSA, moderate lipophilicity, and high sp3 content, but it also has a saturated, non-aromatic scaffold with only modest heteroatom content and no clear signal of the weakly basic cationic amphiphilic character often associated with Vero-active compounds. Taken together, the balance of evidence supports option (A): does not inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication, with score 0.7466.
The overall balance therefore remains on the non-inhibitory side, matching option (A): does not inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication.
